steps.summary: The dashboard save succeeded. Entered edit mode via the "Edit" button, clicked "Save dashboard" (the enabled button in the header indicating unsaved changes), and confirmed in the save dialog by clicking "Save". A "Dashboard saved" alert appeared and the dashboard remained at URL http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfwoa7060hiioe/fwgr10-n3-bench-dashboard (UID cfwoa7060hiioe). The save is confirmed.

Completed all three steps: (1) Opened dashboard settings (gear icon), added the tag "bench" to the Tags field (typed and pressed Enter, then applied/saved settings). (2) Set the time range to "Last 6 hours" via the time range picker. (3) Clicked "Save dashboard" and confirmed — a "Dashboard saved" alert appeared. Verified via API that the dashboard has tags: ["bench"], time: from "now-6h" to "now", and the time range shown in the picker after saving reads "Last 6 hours". Save confirmed successful.

Set the auto-refresh interval to 1m: clicked the refresh-interval dropdown ("Auto refresh turned off"), selected "1 minute" from the list. Then clicked "Save dashboard", checked "Update default refresh value" in the save dialog (since the refresh change was the only delta), and clicked Save. A "Dashboard saved" alert appeared. Verified: the header now shows "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected" / "1m", and the API confirms `"refresh":"1m"`. Save succeeded.
Checked the API at /api/dashboards/uid/cfwoa7060hiioe. The refresh field already IS persisted in the dashboard JSON: "refresh":"1m". No action was needed. Full result below.

Observed the fresh-loaded Grafana dashboard 'fwgr10-n3 Bench Dashboard'. (a) Header title: "fwgr10-n3 Bench Dashboard". (b) Visible panel titles: only one — "fwgr10-n3 Availability". (c) Time range: "Last 6 hours". (d) Auto-refresh: "1m". (e) The panel 'fwgr10-n3 Availability' does NOT render a value — it shows "No data" as its content. (f) There is no 'fwgr10-n3 Notes' text panel on this dashboard (the API confirms only one panel of type timeseries). Verified via live DOM and API.

Executed the fetch call as requested. The dashboard has one panel: type "timeseries", title "fwgr10-n3 Availability", datasource {"type":"datasource","uid":"-- Mixed --"}, and no content field (undefined, omitted by JSON.stringify).
Executed the fetch call for the datasource with UID benchtestdata. The datasource is named "TestData", type "grafana-testdata-datasource", uid "benchtestdata".
